```xml
<listTemplate>
   <banner>
      …
   </banner>
   <list>
      <header>
         …
      </header>
      <section>
         <listItemLockup>
            <title>…</title>
            <relatedContent>
               …
            </relatedContent>
         </listItemLockup
      </section>
   </list>
</listTemplate>
```
